data.description_en:
Hazelnut Chocolate Energy Bars ❄️

Product type: Ready-to-eat frozen snack ❄️

Net weight: 120g (5 bars) ⚖️

Origin: Guangzhou, China 🌍

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 🧾

This isn’t a candy bar pretending to be healthy.

It’s a nut-and-chocolate energy bar built from real ingredients.

Hazelnuts, oats, dates, cacao, and coconut oil come together in a dense, naturally sweet bar with structure and substance.

No tricks. No fluff. Just whole ingredients doing their job.

Best enjoyed cold.

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE IT ⚡

Whole ingredients you can see and taste.

Naturally sweet — no refined white sugar.

Frozen storage keeps texture tight and flavor clean.

INGREDIENTS 🌱

Hazelnuts, quick oats, dates, cacao powder, refined coconut oil, maple syrup, GoVegan crunchy granola, unsweetened cacao mass

CONTAINS / MAY CONTAIN ⚠️

Contains: Tree nuts (hazelnut), gluten (oats)
May contain traces of: Other nuts, soy

FROZEN STORAGE & HOW TO EAT ❄️

Keep frozen to maintain optimal texture and structure.
Enjoy straight from the freezer for a firm, refreshing bite.
Or let sit for 3–5 minutes to soften slightly for a rounder flavor and smoother texture.

NUTRITION (Per bar ~24g) 🧮

Energy 57kcal
Fat 2.6g
Carbohydrate 8.4g
Protein 1.4g

INTENDED USE / NOTES 📌

Plant-based frozen snack 🌿
Best stored and enjoyed frozen
Texture will gradually soften once removed from freezer
data.description_cn:
产品类型：即食冷冻零食 ❄️

净含量：120g（5 条）⚖️

产地：中国广州 🌍

产品描述 🧾

这不是假装健康的糖果棒。

而是一款用真实原料做出来的坚果巧克力能量棒。

榛子、燕麦、椰枣、可可与椰子油结合，口感扎实、自然甜润，没有花招。

饱腹、有结构，适合冷着吃。

为什么人们会选它 ⚡

完整食材，看得见的口感。

天然甜味来源，不使用精制白糖。

冷冻保存，保持最佳质地与风味。

配料表 🌱

榛子仁、快熟燕麦片、椰枣、可可粉、精制椰子油、枫树糖浆、GoVegan 甜脆格兰诺拉麦片、无糖可可膏

致敏原信息 ⚠️

含有：坚果（榛子）、麸质（燕麦）

可能含有微量：其他坚果、大豆

冷冻保存与食用方式 ❄️

建议冷冻保存，以保持最佳口感与结构。

可直接从冷冻柜取出食用，口感紧实清爽；

或静置 3–5 分钟，稍微软化后食用，风味更圆润。

营养信息（每条约 24g）🧮

能量 57kcal

脂肪 2.6g

碳水化合物 8.4g

蛋白质 1.4g

食用提示 📌

植物性冷冻零食 🌿

建议冷冻状态下保存与食用

离开冷冻环境后口感会逐渐变软

description_blocks.body_en: Chocolate-hazelnut on a chewy date-oat crust. No refined sugar in the body of the bar — the sweetness is from the dates and a finishing drizzle of dark chocolate.
description_blocks.body_cn: 可可榛子顶层 + 椰枣燕麦底层。主体不加精制糖，甜味来自椰枣和最后一层黑巧淋面。
